title: Kinetic and thermodynamic characterization of thermosonication-assisted extraction of bioactives from lapsi fruit juice optimized by ANN-GA
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1624-1635
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00233H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Puja Das, Prakash Kumar Nayak, Radha krishnan Kesavan
Thermosonication resulted in the enhancement of nutritional & functional attributes of lapsi fruit juice. Kinetic studies revealed that the thermosonication-based extraction followed a pseudo-second-order model, demonstrating high R2 & low χ2 values.
